rule.twin_a: SHOWN ONLY, never judged (C14 BLOCK option a): post-exit only, (end of the row's blocked window, +183 days]; IWM-adjusted at beta 1, so it carries the lean (1 - beta) x (IWM over the twin windows - IWM over the desk window)

meta.paper_only: Measurement only: nothing the insider desk buys, sizes or exits changes, the IWM ruling (DESK-001) is untouched, and no desk reader consumes this file.

retro_closed.definition: call date <= 2026-10-30 and scored right|wrong by 2026-10-30; outcomes were SEEN before registration - a retrospective reading, never pooled with FORWARD; it changes nothing whatever its verdict

B_same_day_similar_stock.clustered_by: ISO week of the entry bar

A_same_stock_post_exit_shown_only.clustered_by: ISO week of the entry bar
A_same_stock_post_exit_shown_only.caveat: SHOWN ONLY, NEVER JUDGED (C14 BLOCK, option a). Twin A is IWM-adjusted at beta 1, so it carries the lean (1 - beta) x (IWM over the twin windows - IWM over the desk window), shared by every row. On zero-skill prices the reviewer read d_A +1.76 pp (t +3.60) at beta 0.5 and -2.72 pp (t -2.42) at beta 1.5; real betas are far from 1 (dry-cache panel median 0.70, desk names ~1.5). Its sign here is not known in advance. It can neither pass nor fail anything.

retro_closed.overall: RETROSPECTIVE (NO-DIFFERENCE): rows seen before registration; whatever the verdict, this changes nothing and routes nowhere - only the FORWARD reading can

delisted_at_minus_100.note: shown, never judged: scored-wrong rows with no price_at_check at -100%

shown.note: Shown, never judged. The context IWM line uses the twins' own bars; the desk review's IWM figure (close-to-close from the call date, DESK-001) is the standing judgement and is untouched.
